data_source.description: The full resource name of the associated data store for the source entity
data_source.rationale: The source of the data may be confidential or set incorrectly

location.description: The geographic location where the data store should reside. The value can only be one of "global", "us" and "eu".

refresh_interval.description: The refresh interval for data sync.

collection_id.description: The ID to use for the Collection.

collection_display_name.description: The display name of the Collection.

params.description: Params needed to access the source in the format of String-to-String (Key, Value) pairs.
params.rationale: formating of keys to access the data.

json_params.description: Params needed to access the source in the format of json string.
json_params.rationale: Has to be a valid string or else Json data could be leaked.

project.description: If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
